correctness.rationale: Every word induces an Euler trail of its nonnegative undirected ten-edge multiplicity graph; the converse is the exact Euler-trail criterion with loops of degree two. Contributions with 1, 2 and 3 active vertices have connected supports and automatically at most two odd vertices. On 4 vertices, connected simple supports with 3/4/5/6 edges have 16/15/6/1 choices. Four odd degrees occur precisely for eight odd-multiplicity parity subgraphs: 3 perfect matchings, 4 stars and K4. For a matching at least one positive even edge connecting the matched pairs is explicitly enforced, while stars and K4 are connected already. This gives the displayed disjoint rational sum; algebraic cancellation yields \(N(z)/((1-z)^{10}(1+z)^4)\), with \(N(1)=14\) and \(N(-1)=-6\). The poles give exact period two and leading fraction \(7/8\). Actual packaged verify.py independently compared 349520 literal words and 646645 integer profiles with coefficients m=1..12; these finite checks corroborate the infinite proof but are not used as an exhaustive proof.

Gabrys--Milenkovic use ordered L-read multispectra, and Gupta--Mahdavifar use all-length binary compositions. The published binary \(L=2\) exact enumeration and cyclic directed Markov-type asymptotics do not imply the unordered \(q=4\) generating function. claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The full published binary RESULT.md identifies ordered binary counts, whereas this assertion counts unordered quaternary profiles. Equality of pair-multisets implies a different equivalence relation after aggregating orientations and changing alphabet size, so the binary formula does not subsume it. Cyclic balanced directed Markov matrices have different flow constraints. Ye--Elishco \(C_{\le r}\) and Gabrys--Milenkovic ordered L-spectrum do not yield the stated capacity as a corollary. The classical Euler condition is a necessary starting lemma, but it neither tabulates the 4-vertex support/parity fibers nor supplies the exact rational function. The complement is essential: 4 odd vertices are disallowed and contribute an asymptotic eighth of all ten-coordinate profiles.

originality.rationale: The claim is the exact all-length number of realizable quaternary unordered length-two composition multiset profiles, plus its nontrivial four-odd parity correction and asymptotic constant. The inspected closest string reconstruction sources treat all-length binary compositions, growing-length limited compositions, or ordered substring multispectra, while the Markov-type paper has cyclic directed balanced profiles. The published exact binary two-multispectrum theorem does not include quaternary unordered aggregation. Results were compared by observation model and implication, rather than titles alone. The necessary classical Euler-trail theorem alone does not give the explicit rational series. No equivalent exact count was located in the specified actual searches; unindexed multigraph enumerations remain a recorded residual risk.

value.rationale: Quaternary unordered two-read composition observation is a natural smallest-alphabet nontrivial regime: on at most three vertices connectivity implies Euler trail, while four vertices introduce a genuine four-odd obstruction. The theorem determines an exact infinite observation-space size, not merely finite examples, and sharpens its asymptotic density to \(7/8\) with a period-two quasipolynomial law. This yields the exact maximum one-read distinguishable code cardinality for each length, useful for benchmarking composition reconstruction and limiting data rates. The structural parity-fiber decomposition is more specific than a textbook Euler trail existence check.
